## OperationDescriptor.unavailable property

Present when the operation cannot be called: a required position of its input admits no value.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly unavailable?: OperationUnavailability;
```

## Remarks

The descriptor stays in the contract, so the operation keeps its identity and its input still rejects every request. The surfaces that offer operations (MCP tools, HTTP routes, the methods of the generated clients, CLI commands, capability discovery) leave an unavailable operation out, so they never offer a call that must fail, and the runtime answers a call to it exactly as one to an unknown operation.
